source.excerpt: Shared as a low-effort wandering companion that checks in now and then with a note and a picture.

body:
## What it does

You set it going and then mostly leave it alone. It departs on its own, stays away for a while, and comes back with a short note about where it has been plus a postcard-style image to match. Nothing to feed, no streak to protect and no premium currency to buy, which is exactly the appeal. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @coolbat1999 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
